# Preface {.unnumbered #sec-preface}

This short book introduces a few ideas from time series forecasting. It is
also a working demonstration of **quarto-i18n**, a Quarto extension that keeps
machine translations of a book in step with its English source.

The author writes only the English chapters. Every other language is generated
by a translator, checked by the tool, and then improved by readers who review
paragraphs and suggest better wording.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Try it

Switch to *Français* or *Español* in the sidebar, then choose **Review this
page** in the notice at the top of a chapter. Each paragraph shows how many
people have reviewed its translation.
:::

The material follows the approach of @fpp3, which is freely available online.
